policies.text: An item is recommended for municipal procurement listing if it is designated for heavy-duty industrial use and offers a manufacturer warranty of 3 years or longer.
A hardware device obtains green building accreditation if it maintains a power consumption rate of 50 W or lower.
A supply partner attains preferred vendor status with a customer satisfaction index of 90 or above.
A device secures baseline manufacturing approval when it holds an ISO 9001 quality certificate.

Apparatus obtains commercial compliance provided it reaches an energy performance index of 80 or above, keeps an operational noise figure at 45 dB or below, or generates an air delivery rate of at least 1,100 CFM.
A product is designated for heavy-duty industrial use provided it exhibits commercial compliance alongside an IP65 ingress protection rating.
